column11: already approved. BRAFTOVI is indicated, in combination with binimetinib, 'for the treatment of patients with unresectable or metastatic melanoma with a BRAF V600E or V600K mutation' (openFDA drug/label set 235dfc38-0f0b-4037-b501-7a9f4294740c, effective 2026-02-26, section 1.1), with no line-of-therapy restriction. NCT04657991 (STARBOARD, Phase 3, 257 enrolled, primary completion 2026-10-30, primary endpoint objective response by blinded central review) randomises adults with untreated BRAF V600E or V600K unresectable stage IIIB to IIID or stage IV cutaneous melanoma to encorafenib and binimetinib plus pembrolizumab against placebo plus pembrolizumab. Every participant is inside section 1.1, so these patients are inside the 716mm USD anchor
column12: what the readout moves is how many first-line BRAF patients start on the doublet rather than on immunotherapy alone, and for how long, which is the marketed line's growth and persistence, not a new population.
